canonicalBoundary.sourceOfTruth: This JSON, its source manifest, and the adapter contracts are the shared semantic record. Each consumer repository owns its emitted code, project file, media, and test evidence.
notCanonical: Notch .dfxdll blocks, projects, exported media, and HLSL .fx code
GLSL, WGSL, SVG, Canvas, CSS, React, or motion-library implementations
Generated images, videos, meshes, texture maps, prompts, previews, and benchmarks
generatedOutputs: target-local QA receipts with this pack ID and input digest
canonicalBoundary.portableUnit: A mechanism contract: named intent + typed inputs and outputs + declared parameters + invariants + degradation path + QA evidence.

capabilityFamilies.name: Procedural scalar and vector fields
constraints: Declare deterministic seed and time origin when repeatability matters.
Keep simulation state separate from its visual palette.
Provide a static-frame fallback when feedback or float textures are unavailable.
qa: same seed, parameters, resolution, and time must reproduce the same still-frame hash within the target runtime
confirm field update cost at target resolution
verify reduced-motion or paused-state behavior

capabilityFamilies.name: Cellular pattern and topology transformation
constraints: Do not equate a visual Voronoi pattern with a physical fracture simulation.
Declare topology budget before subdivision, tessellation, or greeble operations.
Preserve UV provenance after topology mutation or label the result procedural-only.
qa: record vertex, index, and instance counts
verify mesh renders without normal or UV invalidation
test seam behavior at the intended repeat boundary

capabilityFamilies.name: Particle and agent ecology
constraints: Keep simulation, rendering, and interaction signals independently controllable.
Define a particle-count ceiling and a degradation ladder before production use.
Never describe visual attraction as physics accuracy without a calibrated model.
qa: measure frame time and VRAM at declared count and output resolution
test collision and emitter behavior under a fixed seed
verify safe pause, reset, and reduced-density modes

capabilityFamilies.name: Surface deformation and line/mesh conversion
semanticOperators: convert object to points or lines
constraints: Specify coordinate space for every deformation.
Treat cloth and rope as target-runtime simulations, not portable geometry facts.
Maintain a low-cost mesh or image-plane fallback for web targets.
qa: check normals, winding, and silhouette continuity
compare vertex count before and after topology operations
validate parameter extrema against self-intersection or clipping

capabilityFamilies.name: Material, lighting, and renderer intent
constraints: Canonical material intent is renderer-neutral; numeric maps are adapter outputs.
State whether glass, iridescence, bloom, and dispersion are physical approximations or expressive effects.
Pair any high-cost optical effect with a bounded fallback.
qa: compare material identity under at least two lighting angles
test HDR and SDR grade behavior
measure visual and performance deltas with optical effects disabled

capabilityFamilies.name: Image, video, text, and post-processing signal chain
constraints: Record alpha, color space, resolution, frame rate, and loop boundary as part of the asset contract.
Feedback must have a reset route and bounded gain.
Avoid relying on a stylization effect to conceal invalid source images or artifacts.
qa: verify first/last frame continuity when looping
inspect alpha and color-channel behavior
test source-loss or unavailable-video fallback

capabilityFamilies.name: Interactive control, modulation, and operator surface
constraints: Name and group exposed controls by intention, not internal node trivia.
Specify default, minimum, maximum, units, smoothing, and reset semantics.
A host can overwrite exposed values; downstream adapters must state ownership and precedence.
qa: export or generate a parameter manifest
test safe extrema and reset behavior
test keyboard-only operation and reduced-motion control paths when a web UI consumes the contract

capabilityFamilies.name: Bounded model-mediated image effect
constraints: Only image-to-image ONNX usage is claimed for Notch 2026.2.
Model compatibility is a test obligation, not an assumption.
Keep model provenance, rights, and input dimensions visible; do not ingest weights into the pack.
qa: record model hash, input dimensions, target GPU/driver, and observed latency
test missing-model and incompatible-model failure behavior
review source entitlement before storing derived output

sceneRecipes.name: Radial Field Bloom
sceneRecipes.purpose: A controllable organic radial motion study: vector flow moves a colored density field through a bounded feedback loop, with a still-frame fallback for low-power targets.
notchBuildOrder: Fractal Noise or Radial Vortex → Field Procedural Affector
Curl Noise or Vortex Affector → Field Feedback
Field 3D Renderer → Field Colour Ramp Material
Colour Grade or Glow as optional output stage
Expose seed, flow, feedback, palette, and motion controls through grouped values
qa: fixed seed still must be reproducible
feedback=0 must render a valid first frame
reduced-motion path must freeze or use a static procedural frame

sceneRecipes.name: Cellular Reconstruction
sceneRecipes.purpose: A material or architecture study that moves from Voronoi or Truchet segmentation to controlled depth, linework, and surface relief without confusing pattern generation with physical fabrication.
notchBuildOrder: Voronoi or Truchet Generator → map or mask
Object To Lines / Lines To Mesh or topology operations as required
Displacement, Extrude, Bevel, or Voronoi Fracture only under mesh budget
Material and lighting intent pass
Emit source mesh and surface-profile metadata separately
qa: record mesh budget before topology transformation
inspect seams, normals, and silhouettes
keep a flat texture fallback

sceneRecipes.name: Signal Garden
sceneRecipes.purpose: A particle ecology where audio, pointer, camera, or tracking signals perturb but do not erase a legible base flow.
notchBuildOrder: Mesh/Primitive/Image Emitter → particle root
Field/Vortex/Turbulence/Points Affectors → particle state
Attribute/Life/Noise shading → particle renderer or trails
Bind audio or interaction input through smoothed modifier
Expose budget, gain, pause, and density controls
qa: test reset to a known seed
capture GPU cost at low, medium, and high density
ensure controls remain understandable when input signal is absent

sceneRecipes.name: Optical Surface Ritual
sceneRecipes.purpose: A surface study for glass, nacre-like iridescence, metallic or subsurface response, and expressive bloom—always declaring which response is physically grounded and which is a visual treatment.
notchBuildOrder: Surface mesh or image plane → normal/displacement signal
Material assignment → named lighting rig
Render node selected to target frame budget
Optional physical glow/colour grade pass
Capture beauty, normal, depth, and parameter manifest where available
qa: compare at two camera or light angles
test visual identity with bloom disabled
provide SDR-safe grade and a no-transmission fallback

sceneRecipes.name: Inference Matte Loop
sceneRecipes.purpose: A bounded image-to-image or segmentation-like preprocessing loop that turns permitted source frames into a live mask or treatment while preserving model and input provenance.
notchBuildOrder: Permitted input video/image → resize to model contract
AI Model Post-FX → mask or derived frame
threshold/feather/composite stage
Expose enable, threshold, and fallback only; do not expose hidden model assumptions
write inference receipt outside the scene
qa: missing or incompatible model must fall back without a blank frame
record model hash and dimensions
human review must confirm source and derived-output rights

maps: official Notch source locators → a versioned source manifest
scene recipes → target-neutral parameter and QA contracts
qa: npm run capability:notch:verify
npm run capability:notch:test
review source rights before adding excerpts, assets, or model weights

qa: SVG recipe compiler test

governance.promotionRule: A capability family or adapter may become reviewed only when a named target implementation returns its local test receipt and a reviewer confirms that the implementation stayed within the contract. Approval is a separate human decision.
governance.rightsBoundary: Store links, hashes, concise original facts, and user-authored mechanism contracts. Do not mirror copyrighted manual content, images, source code, model weights, or proprietary blocks into this pack.
stopConditions: A requested implementation requires copying or redistributing protected source material, assets, model weights, or proprietary block binaries.
An adapter claims renderer, physics, model, or visual equivalence without a target-specific measurement.
A target repository is inaccessible, its branch/base is unknown, or its license and asset-rights constraints conflict with this pack.
The work expands into a general marketplace, registry, ontology, telemetry platform, or auto-deployment system before a bounded two-target proof demonstrates the need.
